verdict.rationale: Terraform, through HCP Terraform, hosts user state, configuration and workspace data, so an AI-training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI training on user data, data-usage policies, or opt-out controls. The MCP server docs only describe giving AI models access to registry docs and workspaces, which is unrelated to training on user data.
